welcome_page.title: Welcome to Safety
welcome_page.image_alt: #Street lamp at night with a safety shield
welcome_page.description:
Questions about road safety and personal security during your journeys.

Participation is voluntary. Your answers are not linked to your name. See the privacy information for details.

final_page.title: Thank you!
final_page.description: Your submission has been recorded. Thank you for taking the time to complete the questionnaire.

sections.title: Safety and Security
sections.description: Questions about safety (protection from accidents or physical harm) and security (protection from crime, harassment, or feeling unsafe) during your usual journeys.

questions.text: Thinking about your typical trip (the trip you make most often in a typical week), how safe are the streets you use, including pavements and crossings, in terms of traffic and road conditions?

options.text: Not safe at all
Slightly safe
Moderately safe
Very safe
Completely safe

questions.text: When you walk (also with a pushchair, a cane or another aid) or use a wheelchair, how do roads with fast traffic affect you when you go along or cross them?

options.text: They don't affect me
I feel a little uneasy
I feel unsafe and stay near them as little as possible
I take much longer routes to avoid them
I avoid trips that make me use them
I don't use roads like these
Not for me: I rarely get around on foot or in a wheelchair

questions.text: Which situations on a trip do you consider most unsafe?

options.text: Heavy or fast-moving traffic
Lack of safe or adequate infrastructure (e.g. sidewalks, crossings, cycle paths, lighting)
Poor road or pathway conditions (e.g. potholes, debris, uneven surfaces)
Poor visibility or limited sightlines
Unsafe behavior from drivers, riders, or pedestrians
Crowding or conflicts with other road users
Absence of emergency services
I don't feel unsafe at all

questions.text: During the day, how secure do you feel from crime or harassment on your usual trip? (Harassment includes unwanted comments, following, touching, or intimidating behaviour directed at you.)

options.text: I don't feel secure at all
I feel slightly secure
I feel moderately secure
I feel very secure
I feel completely secure

questions.text: In the evening or after dark, how secure do you feel from crime or harassment on your usual trip?

options.text: I don't feel secure at all
I feel slightly secure
I feel moderately secure
I feel very secure
I feel completely secure
I don't travel in the evening or after dark

questions.text: When you don't feel safe in the evening, what do you usually do?

options.text: I still travel in the evening because I have to
I still go out, but I change my route, stop or company
I avoid travelling in the evening

questions.text: Which factors most reduce your feeling of security from crime or harassment?

options.text: Poor lighting (e.g., dark streets, underpasses)
Lack of people around (isolated or deserted areas)
People behaving aggressively or harassing others
Harassment experienced or feared because of who I am or how I look (e.g. gender, appearance, origin, age)
Long waits at stops in the evening
Overcrowding or chaotic environments
Poor visibility (e.g., blind corners, obstructed views)
Poor maintenance (e.g., abandoned buildings, graffiti, broken infrastructure)
Lack of surveillance or security measures (e.g., no cameras, no staff)
Previous personal or reported incidents in the area
I don't feel insecure at all

questions.text: When you walk after dark, does poor street lighting change your route or when you go out?

options.text: No, it makes no difference to me
I notice it, but I don't change anything
I go the same way but faster, or avoid some spots
I take a longer, better-lit route
I don't walk after dark because of poor lighting
I don't walk after dark for other reasons
Lighting doesn't matter to me because I don't rely on sight

it.#Welcome to Safety: Ti diamo il benvenuto nel questionario sulla sicurezza
it.#<p>Questions about road safety and pers:
Domande sulla sicurezza stradale e personale durante i tuoi spostamenti.

La partecipazione è volontaria. Le tue risposte non sono collegate al tuo nome. Consulta l'informativa sulla privacy per i dettagli.
it.#<p>Questions about safety (protection f: Domande sulla sicurezza stradale (protezione da incidenti o danni fisici) e personale (protezione da reati, molestie o sensazione di insicurezza) durante gli spostamenti abituali.
it.#<p>Your submission has been recorded. T: La tua risposta è stata registrata. Grazie per il tempo dedicato alla compilazione del questionario.
it.#Thinking about your typical trip (the t: Pensando al tuo spostamento abituale (quello che fai più spesso in una settimana tipica), quanto è sicuro muoverti sulle strade che usi, compresi marciapiedi e attraversamenti, per quanto riguarda il traffico e le condizioni della strada?
it.#When you walk (also with a pushchair, a: Quando cammini (anche con passeggino, bastone o altro ausilio) o usi la sedia a rotelle, che effetto ti fanno le strade con traffico veloce quando le percorri o le attraversi?
it.#I feel a little uneasy: Mi sento un po' a disagio
it.#I feel unsafe and stay near them as lit: Non mi sento al sicuro e ci passo il meno possibile
it.#I take much longer routes to avoid them: Faccio percorsi molto più lunghi per evitarle
it.#I avoid trips that make me use them: Evito gli spostamenti che mi obbligano a passarci
it.#I don't use roads like these: Non passo da strade di questo tipo
it.#Not for me: I rarely get around on foot: Non mi riguarda: mi muovo raramente a piedi o in sedia a rotelle
it.#Which situations on a trip do you consi: Quali situazioni consideri più pericolose durante uno spostamento?
it.#Heavy or fast-moving traffic: Traffico intenso o ad alta velocità
it.#Lack of safe or adequate infrastructure: Mancanza di infrastrutture sicure o adeguate (ad es. marciapiedi, attraversamenti, piste ciclabili, illuminazione)
it.#Poor road or pathway conditions (e.g. p: Cattive condizioni della strada o dei percorsi (ad es. buche, detriti, superfici irregolari)
it.#Unsafe behavior from drivers, riders, o: Comportamenti pericolosi di chi guida, di chi va in bici o di chi va a piedi
it.#Crowding or conflicts with other road u: Affollamento o conflitti con altre persone in strada
it.#I don't feel unsafe at all: Non mi sento affatto in pericolo
it.#During the day, how secure do you feel: Durante il giorno, quanto ti senti al sicuro da reati o molestie durante lo spostamento abituale? (Le molestie includono commenti indesiderati, pedinamenti, contatti fisici o comportamenti intimidatori.)
it.#I don't feel secure at all: Non mi sento per niente al sicuro
it.#I feel completely secure: Mi sento del tutto al sicuro
it.#In the evening or after dark, how secur: Di sera o dopo il tramonto, quanto ti senti al sicuro da reati o molestie durante lo spostamento abituale?
it.#I don't travel in the evening or after: Non mi sposto di sera o dopo il tramonto
it.#When you don't feel safe in the evening: Quando la sera non ti senti al sicuro, cosa fai di solito?
it.#I still travel in the evening because I: Mi sposto comunque la sera perché devo
it.#I still go out, but I change my route,: Esco lo stesso, ma cambio percorso, fermata o compagnia
it.#Which factors most reduce your feeling: Quali fattori riducono maggiormente la tua percezione di sicurezza rispetto a reati o molestie?
it.#Poor lighting (e.g., dark streets, unde: Scarsa illuminazione (ad es. strade buie, sottopassaggi)
it.#Lack of people around (isolated or dese: Assenza di persone nelle vicinanze (zone isolate o deserte)
it.#People behaving aggressively or harassi: Persone aggressive o che molestano altre persone
it.#Harassment experienced or feared becaus: Molestie subite o temute per chi sono o per come appaio (es. genere, aspetto, origine, età)
it.#Long waits at stops in the evening: Lunghe attese alle fermate di sera
it.#Poor visibility (e.g., blind corners, o: Scarsa visibilità (ad es. angoli ciechi, visuale ostruita)
it.#Poor maintenance (e.g., abandoned build: Scarsa manutenzione (ad es. edifici abbandonati, graffiti, infrastrutture danneggiate)
it.#Lack of surveillance or security measur: Mancanza di sorveglianza o misure di sicurezza (ad es. assenza di telecamere o personale)
it.#Previous personal or reported incidents: Precedenti episodi personali o segnalati nella zona
it.#I don't feel insecure at all: Non mi sento mai a rischio
it.#When you walk after dark, does poor str: Quando cammini dopo il tramonto, la scarsa illuminazione cambia il tuo percorso o l'orario in cui esci?
it.#No, it makes no difference to me: No, per me non cambia nulla
it.#I notice it, but I don't change anythin: Me ne accorgo, ma non cambio nulla
it.#I go the same way but faster, or avoid: Faccio la stessa strada ma più veloce, o evito alcuni punti
it.#I take a longer, better-lit route: Faccio un percorso più lungo e meglio illuminato
it.#I don't walk after dark because of poor: Non cammino dopo il tramonto per la scarsa illuminazione
it.#I don't walk after dark for other reaso: Non cammino dopo il tramonto per altri motivi
it.#Lighting doesn't matter to me because I: L'illuminazione per me non conta, perché non mi oriento con la vista
it.#Street lamp at night with a safety shie: Lampione di notte con uno scudo di sicurezza

fr.#Welcome to Safety: Bienvenue dans le questionnaire sur la sécurité
fr.#<p>Questions about road safety and pers:
Des questions sur la sécurité routière et la sécurité personnelle pendant vos déplacements.

La participation est volontaire. Vos réponses ne sont pas associées à votre nom. Consultez les informations sur la protection des données pour en savoir plus.
fr.#<p>Questions about safety (protection f: Des questions sur la sécurité routière (protection contre les accidents ou les blessures physiques) et la sécurité personnelle (protection contre la criminalité, le harcèlement ou le sentiment d’insécurité) pendant vos déplacements habituels.
fr.#<p>Your submission has been recorded. T: Votre réponse a bien été enregistrée. Merci d’avoir pris le temps de remplir ce questionnaire.
fr.#Thinking about your typical trip (the t: En pensant à votre trajet habituel (celui que vous faites le plus souvent au cours d’une semaine type), à quel point est-il sûr de circuler dans les rues que vous empruntez, trottoirs et passages piétons compris, côté circulation et état de la chaussée ?
fr.#When you walk (also with a pushchair, a: Quand vous marchez (même avec une poussette, une canne ou une autre aide) ou que vous utilisez un fauteuil roulant, que ressentez-vous sur les routes à circulation rapide, quand vous les longez ou les traversez ?
fr.#I feel a little uneasy: Je me sens un peu mal à l'aise
fr.#I feel unsafe and stay near them as lit: Je ne me sens pas en sécurité et j’y reste le moins possible
fr.#I take much longer routes to avoid them: Je fais des détours bien plus longs pour les éviter
fr.#I avoid trips that make me use them: J’évite les trajets qui m’obligent à les emprunter
fr.#I don't use roads like these: Je n’emprunte pas de routes de ce genre
fr.#Not for me: I rarely get around on foot: Cela ne me concerne pas : je me déplace rarement à pied ou en fauteuil roulant
fr.#Which situations on a trip do you consi: Quelles situations vous semblent les plus dangereuses pendant un déplacement ?
fr.#Heavy or fast-moving traffic: Trafic dense ou véhicules roulant vite
fr.#Lack of safe or adequate infrastructure: Manque d’infrastructures sûres ou adaptées (par ex. trottoirs, traversées, pistes cyclables, éclairage)
fr.#Poor road or pathway conditions (e.g. p: Routes ou chemins en mauvais état (par ex. nids-de-poule, débris, surfaces irrégulières)
fr.#Poor visibility or limited sightlines: Mauvaise visibilité ou champ de vision limité
fr.#Unsafe behavior from drivers, riders, o: Comportement dangereux de personnes en voiture, à deux-roues ou à pied
fr.#Crowding or conflicts with other road u: Forte affluence ou conflits avec d’autres personnes qui circulent
fr.#I don't feel unsafe at all: Je ne me sens jamais en danger
fr.#During the day, how secure do you feel: Pendant la journée, dans quelle mesure vous sentez-vous à l’abri de la criminalité ou du harcèlement lors de votre trajet habituel ? (Le harcèlement comprend les commentaires non désirés, le fait que quelqu’un vous suive, les attouchements ou les comportements intimidants à votre égard.)
fr.#I don't feel secure at all: Je ne me sens pas du tout en sécurité
fr.#I feel slightly secure: Je me sens peu en sécurité
fr.#I feel moderately secure: Je me sens modérément en sécurité
fr.#I feel very secure: Je me sens tout à fait en sécurité
fr.#I feel completely secure: Je me sens complètement en sécurité
fr.#In the evening or after dark, how secur: Le soir ou après la tombée de la nuit, dans quelle mesure vous sentez-vous à l’abri de la criminalité ou du harcèlement lors de votre trajet habituel ?
fr.#I don't travel in the evening or after: Je ne me déplace pas le soir ni après la tombée de la nuit
fr.#When you don't feel safe in the evening: Quand vous ne vous sentez pas en sécurité le soir, que faites-vous habituellement ?
fr.#I still travel in the evening because I: Je me déplace quand même le soir parce que je dois le faire
fr.#I still go out, but I change my route,: Je sors quand même, mais je change d’itinéraire, d’arrêt ou de compagnie
fr.#I avoid travelling in the evening: J’évite de me déplacer le soir
fr.#Which factors most reduce your feeling: Quels facteurs réduisent le plus votre sentiment de sécurité face à la criminalité ou au harcèlement ?
fr.#Poor lighting (e.g., dark streets, unde: Mauvais éclairage (par ex. rues sombres, passages souterrains)
fr.#Lack of people around (isolated or dese: Peu ou pas de personnes autour (zones isolées ou désertes)
fr.#People behaving aggressively or harassi: Personnes au comportement agressif ou qui harcèlent d’autres personnes
fr.#Harassment experienced or feared becaus: Harcèlement subi ou redouté en raison de qui je suis ou de mon aspect (par ex. genre, apparence, origine, âge)
fr.#Long waits at stops in the evening: Longues attentes aux arrêts le soir
fr.#Overcrowding or chaotic environments: Trop de monde ou environnement désordonné
fr.#Poor visibility (e.g., blind corners, o: Mauvaise visibilité (par ex. angles morts, vue bloquée)
fr.#Poor maintenance (e.g., abandoned build: Mauvais entretien (par ex. bâtiments abandonnés, graffitis, infrastructures cassées)
fr.#Lack of surveillance or security measur: Manque de surveillance ou de mesures de sécurité (par ex. pas de caméra, pas de personnel)
fr.#Previous personal or reported incidents: Incidents déjà vécus ou signalés dans la zone
fr.#I don't feel insecure at all: Je ne me sens pas du tout en insécurité
fr.#When you walk after dark, does poor str: Quand vous marchez après la tombée de la nuit, un mauvais éclairage change-t-il votre itinéraire ou le moment où vous sortez ?
fr.#No, it makes no difference to me: Non, cela ne change rien pour moi
fr.#I notice it, but I don't change anythin: Je le remarque, mais je ne change rien
fr.#I go the same way but faster, or avoid: Je passe par le même chemin, mais plus vite, ou j'évite certains endroits
fr.#I take a longer, better-lit route: Je prends un itinéraire plus long et mieux éclairé
fr.#I don't walk after dark because of poor: Je ne marche pas après la tombée de la nuit à cause du mauvais éclairage
fr.#I don't walk after dark for other reaso: Je ne marche pas après la tombée de la nuit pour d'autres raisons
fr.#Lighting doesn't matter to me because I: L'éclairage m'est indifférent, car je ne me repère pas avec la vue
fr.#Street lamp at night with a safety shie: Lampadaire la nuit avec un bouclier de sécurité

de.#<p>Questions about road safety and pers:
Fragen zur Verkehrssicherheit und zur persönlichen Sicherheit auf Ihren Wegen.

Die Teilnahme ist freiwillig. Ihre Antworten werden nicht mit Ihrem Namen verknüpft. Einzelheiten finden Sie in den Datenschutzhinweisen.
de.#<p>Questions about safety (protection f: Fragen zur Verkehrssicherheit (Schutz vor Unfällen oder körperlichen Verletzungen) und zur persönlichen Sicherheit (Schutz vor Kriminalität, Belästigung oder einem Gefühl der Unsicherheit) auf Ihren üblichen Wegen.
de.#<p>Your submission has been recorded. T: Ihre Antwort wurde gespeichert. Vielen Dank, dass Sie sich Zeit für diesen Fragebogen genommen haben.
de.#Thinking about your typical trip (the t: Wenn Sie an Ihren typischen Weg denken (den Weg, den Sie in einer typischen Woche am häufigsten zurücklegen): Wie sicher sind die Straßen, die Sie nutzen, einschließlich Gehwegen und Überwegen, in Bezug auf Verkehr und Straßenzustand?
de.#When you walk (also with a pushchair, a: Wenn Sie zu Fuß gehen (auch mit Kinderwagen, Stock oder anderer Gehhilfe) oder einen Rollstuhl nutzen: Wie wirken Straßen mit schnellem Verkehr auf Sie, wenn Sie an ihnen entlanggehen oder sie überqueren?
de.#I feel unsafe and stay near them as lit: Ich fühle mich unsicher und halte mich möglichst kurz dort auf
de.#I take much longer routes to avoid them: Ich nehme viel längere Wege, um sie zu vermeiden
de.#I avoid trips that make me use them: Ich vermeide Wege, auf denen ich sie benutzen muss
de.#Not for me: I rarely get around on foot: Trifft auf mich nicht zu: Ich bin selten zu Fuß oder im Rollstuhl unterwegs
de.#Which situations on a trip do you consi: Welche Situationen auf einem Weg empfinden Sie als am unsichersten?
de.#Lack of safe or adequate infrastructure: Fehlende sichere oder geeignete Infrastruktur (z. B. Gehwege, Querungen, Radwege, Beleuchtung)
de.#Poor road or pathway conditions (e.g. p: Schlechter Zustand von Straßen oder Wegen (z. B. Schlaglöcher, Schmutz, unebene Flächen)
de.#Unsafe behavior from drivers, riders, o: Gefährliches Verhalten von Autofahrenden, Zweiradfahrenden oder zu Fuß Gehenden
de.#Crowding or conflicts with other road u: Überfüllung oder Konflikte mit anderen Verkehrsteilnehmenden
de.#I don't feel unsafe at all: Ich fühle mich überhaupt nicht gefährdet
de.#During the day, how secure do you feel: Wie sicher fühlen Sie sich tagsüber auf Ihrem üblichen Weg vor Kriminalität oder Belästigung? (Belästigung umfasst unerwünschte Kommentare, Verfolgen, Berührungen oder einschüchterndes Verhalten Ihnen gegenüber.)
de.#I don't feel secure at all: Ich fühle mich überhaupt nicht sicher
de.#In the evening or after dark, how secur: Wie sicher fühlen Sie sich abends oder nach Einbruch der Dunkelheit auf Ihrem üblichen Weg vor Kriminalität oder Belästigung?
de.#I don't travel in the evening or after: Ich bin abends oder nach Einbruch der Dunkelheit nicht unterwegs
de.#When you don't feel safe in the evening: Was tun Sie in der Regel, wenn Sie sich abends nicht sicher fühlen?
de.#I still travel in the evening because I: Ich bin trotzdem abends unterwegs, weil ich muss
de.#I still go out, but I change my route,: Ich gehe trotzdem aus dem Haus, ändere aber meine Route, Haltestelle oder Begleitung
de.#I avoid travelling in the evening: Ich vermeide es, abends unterwegs zu sein
de.#Which factors most reduce your feeling: Welche Faktoren verringern Ihr Sicherheitsgefühl in Bezug auf Kriminalität oder Belästigung am stärksten?
de.#Poor lighting (e.g., dark streets, unde: Schlechte Beleuchtung (z. B. dunkle Straßen, Unterführungen)
de.#Lack of people around (isolated or dese: Wenig oder keine Menschen in der Umgebung (einsame oder verlassene Bereiche)
de.#People behaving aggressively or harassi: Menschen, die sich aggressiv verhalten oder andere belästigen
de.#Harassment experienced or feared becaus: Erlebte oder befürchtete Belästigung wegen meiner Person oder wie ich wirke (z. B. Geschlecht, Aussehen, Herkunft, Alter)
de.#Long waits at stops in the evening: Lange Wartezeiten an Haltestellen am Abend
de.#Poor visibility (e.g., blind corners, o: Schlechte Sicht (z. B. unübersichtliche Ecken, versperrte Sicht)
de.#Poor maintenance (e.g., abandoned build: Schlechte Instandhaltung (z. B. verlassene Gebäude, Graffiti, beschädigte Infrastruktur)
de.#Lack of surveillance or security measur: Fehlende Überwachung oder Sicherheitsmaßnahmen (z. B. keine Kameras, kein Personal)
de.#Previous personal or reported incidents: Frühere eigene Erlebnisse oder gemeldete Vorfälle in diesem Bereich
de.#I don't feel insecure at all: Ich fühle mich überhaupt nicht unsicher
de.#When you walk after dark, does poor str: Wenn Sie nach Einbruch der Dunkelheit zu Fuß gehen: Ändert schlechte Straßenbeleuchtung Ihren Weg oder den Zeitpunkt, zu dem Sie rausgehen?
de.#No, it makes no difference to me: Nein, für mich macht es keinen Unterschied
de.#I notice it, but I don't change anythin: Ich bemerke es, ändere aber nichts
de.#I go the same way but faster, or avoid: Ich gehe denselben Weg, aber schneller, oder meide manche Stellen
de.#I take a longer, better-lit route: Ich nehme einen längeren, besser beleuchteten Weg
de.#I don't walk after dark because of poor: Ich gehe wegen schlechter Beleuchtung nach Einbruch der Dunkelheit nicht zu Fuß
de.#I don't walk after dark for other reaso: Ich gehe aus anderen Gründen nach Einbruch der Dunkelheit nicht zu Fuß
de.#Lighting doesn't matter to me because I: Beleuchtung spielt für mich keine Rolle, weil ich mich nicht auf mein Sehen verlasse
de.#Street lamp at night with a safety shie: Straßenlaterne bei Nacht mit einem Schutzschild

tr.#<p>Questions about road safety and pers:
Yolculuklarınız sırasında trafik güvenliği ve kişisel güvenlik hakkında sorular.

Katılım gönüllüdür. Yanıtlarınız adınızla ilişkilendirilmez. Ayrıntılar için gizlilik bilgilendirmesine bakın.
tr.#<p>Questions about safety (protection f: Her zamanki yolculuklarınız sırasında trafik güvenliği (kazalardan veya fiziksel zarardan korunma) ve kişisel güvenlik (suçtan, tacizden veya güvensizlik hissinden korunma) hakkında sorular.
tr.#<p>Your submission has been recorded. T: Yanıtınız kaydedildi. Bu anketi doldurmak için zaman ayırdığınız için teşekkür ederiz.
tr.#Thinking about your typical trip (the t: Tipik yolculuğunuzu (tipik bir haftada en sık yaptığınız yolculuk) düşündüğünüzde, kullandığınız sokaklar, kaldırımlar ve yaya geçitleri dahil, trafik ve yol koşulları açısından ne kadar güvenli?
tr.#When you walk (also with a pushchair, a: Yürürken (bebek arabası, baston veya başka bir yardımcı araçla da olsa) ya da tekerlekli sandalye kullanırken, trafiğin hızlı aktığı yollar boyunca giderken veya karşıdan karşıya geçerken sizi nasıl etkiliyor?
tr.#I feel unsafe and stay near them as lit: Kendimi güvensiz hisseder ve orada olabildiğince az kalırım
tr.#I take much longer routes to avoid them: Onlardan kaçınmak için çok daha uzun güzergâhlar kullanırım
tr.#Not for me: I rarely get around on foot: Bu soru benim için geçerli değil: Yaya veya tekerlekli sandalyeyle nadiren dolaşırım
tr.#Which situations on a trip do you consi: Yolculuk sırasında hangi durumları en tehlikeli buluyorsunuz?
tr.#Lack of safe or adequate infrastructure: Güvenli veya yeterli altyapının olmaması (ör. kaldırımlar, geçişler, bisiklet yolları, aydınlatma)
tr.#Poor road or pathway conditions (e.g. p: Yol veya patikaların kötü durumda olması (ör. çukurlar, moloz, düzensiz yüzeyler)
tr.#Poor visibility or limited sightlines: Kötü görüş veya sınırlı görüş mesafesi
tr.#Unsafe behavior from drivers, riders, o: Sürücülerin, iki tekerlekli araç kullanıcılarının veya yayaların tehlikeli davranışları
tr.#Crowding or conflicts with other road u: Kalabalık veya diğer yol kullanıcılarıyla çatışma
tr.#During the day, how secure do you feel: Gündüz, her zamanki yolculuğunuzda kendinizi suça veya tacize karşı ne kadar güvende hissediyorsunuz? (Taciz; size yönelik istenmeyen yorumları, takip edilmeyi, dokunmayı veya yıldırıcı davranışları kapsar.)
tr.#In the evening or after dark, how secur: Akşamları veya hava karardıktan sonra, her zamanki yolculuğunuzda kendinizi suça veya tacize karşı ne kadar güvende hissediyorsunuz?
tr.#I don't travel in the evening or after: Akşamları veya hava karardıktan sonra yolculuk yapmıyorum
tr.#When you don't feel safe in the evening: Akşamları kendinizi güvende hissetmediğinizde genellikle ne yaparsınız?
tr.#I still travel in the evening because I: Yine de akşamları yolculuk yapıyorum, çünkü mecburum
tr.#I still go out, but I change my route,: Yine de dışarı çıkıyorum, ama güzergâhımı, durağımı veya yanımdaki kişileri değiştiriyorum
tr.#Which factors most reduce your feeling: Suça veya tacize karşı güvenlik hissinizi en çok hangi etkenler azaltıyor?
tr.#Poor lighting (e.g., dark streets, unde: Yetersiz aydınlatma (ör. karanlık sokaklar, alt geçitler)
tr.#Lack of people around (isolated or dese: Çevrede insanların olmaması (ıssız veya tenha alanlar)
tr.#People behaving aggressively or harassi: Saldırgan davranan veya başkalarını taciz eden kişiler
tr.#Harassment experienced or feared becaus: Kim olduğum ya da nasıl göründüğüm nedeniyle yaşadığım veya korktuğum taciz (örn. cinsiyet, görünüş, köken, yaş)
tr.#Poor visibility (e.g., blind corners, o: Kötü görüş (ör. kör noktalar, kapanmış görüş alanı)
tr.#Poor maintenance (e.g., abandoned build: Kötü bakım (ör. terk edilmiş binalar, grafiti, hasarlı altyapı)
tr.#Lack of surveillance or security measur: Gözetim veya güvenlik önlemlerinin olmaması (ör. kamera veya görevli olmaması)
tr.#Previous personal or reported incidents: Bölgede daha önce yaşanmış veya bildirilmiş olaylar
tr.#When you walk after dark, does poor str: Hava karardıktan sonra yürürken, yetersiz sokak aydınlatması güzergâhınızı veya dışarı çıkma zamanınızı değiştiriyor mu?
tr.#I notice it, but I don't change anythin: Fark ederim ama hiçbir şeyi değiştirmem
tr.#I go the same way but faster, or avoid: Aynı yoldan giderim ama daha hızlı yürür veya bazı yerlerden kaçınırım
tr.#I take a longer, better-lit route: Daha uzun ama daha iyi aydınlatılmış bir güzergâh seçerim
tr.#I don't walk after dark because of poor: Yetersiz aydınlatma nedeniyle hava karardıktan sonra yürümem
tr.#I don't walk after dark for other reaso: Başka nedenlerle hava karardıktan sonra yürümem
tr.#Lighting doesn't matter to me because I: Görmeye dayanmadığım için aydınlatma benim için önemli değil
tr.#Street lamp at night with a safety shie: Gece bir sokak lambası ve güvenlik kalkanı

fa.#<p>Questions about road safety and pers:
پرسش‌هایی درباره ایمنی ترافیکی و امنیت شخصی در طول رفت‌وآمدهای شما.

شرکت در این پرسشنامه داوطلبانه است. پاسخ‌های شما به نام شما مرتبط نمی‌شود. برای جزئیات، اطلاعات مربوط به حریم خصوصی را ببینید.
fa.#<p>Questions about safety (protection f: پرسش‌هایی درباره ایمنی (محافظت در برابر تصادف یا آسیب جسمی) و امنیت (محافظت در برابر جرم، آزار یا احساس ناامنی) در طول رفت‌وآمدهای معمول شما.
fa.#<p>Your submission has been recorded. T: پاسخ شما ثبت شد. از وقتی که برای تکمیل این پرسشنامه گذاشتید سپاسگزاریم.
fa.#Thinking about your typical trip (the t: با در نظر گرفتن سفر معمول خود (سفری که در یک هفته معمولی بیشتر از همه انجام می‌دهید)، خیابان‌هایی که استفاده می‌کنید، از جمله پیاده‌روها و گذرگاه‌ها، از نظر ترافیک و وضعیت جاده چقدر امن هستند؟
fa.#When you walk (also with a pushchair, a: وقتی پیاده راه می‌روید (حتی با کالسکه، عصا یا وسیله کمکی دیگر) یا از ویلچر استفاده می‌کنید، خیابان‌های پرسرعت چه حسی به شما می‌دهند، هنگام رفتن در امتداد آن‌ها یا عبور از آن‌ها؟
fa.#I feel unsafe and stay near them as lit: احساس ناامنی می‌کنم و تا جای ممکن کمتر کنار آن‌ها می‌مانم
fa.#I take much longer routes to avoid them: برای دوری از آن‌ها مسیرهای بسیار طولانی‌تری انتخاب می‌کنم
fa.#I avoid trips that make me use them: از سفرهایی که مجبورم از آن‌ها استفاده کنم پرهیز می‌کنم
fa.#I don't use roads like these: از خیابان‌هایی از این نوع استفاده نمی‌کنم
fa.#Not for me: I rarely get around on foot: مربوط به من نیست: کم پیش می‌آید پیاده یا با ویلچر جابه‌جا شوم
fa.#Which situations on a trip do you consi: کدام موقعیت‌ها را در طول سفر خطرناک‌ترین می‌دانید؟
fa.#Lack of safe or adequate infrastructure: نبود زیرساخت ایمن یا مناسب (مثلاً پیاده‌رو، گذرگاه، مسیر دوچرخه، روشنایی)
fa.#Poor road or pathway conditions (e.g. p: وضعیت نامناسب خیابان یا مسیر (مثلاً چاله، زباله، سطح ناهموار)
fa.#Poor visibility or limited sightlines: دید ضعیف یا میدان دید محدود
fa.#Unsafe behavior from drivers, riders, o: رفتار خطرناک رانندگان، موتورسواران، دوچرخه‌سواران یا عابران
fa.#Crowding or conflicts with other road u: شلوغی یا برخورد و تعارض با سایر کاربران راه
fa.#During the day, how secure do you feel: در طول روز، در سفر معمول خود چقدر در برابر جرم یا آزار احساس امنیت می‌کنید؟ (آزار شامل اظهارنظرهای ناخواسته، تعقیب کردن، لمس کردن یا رفتار ارعاب‌آمیز نسبت به شما است.)
fa.#I feel moderately secure: تا حد متوسطی احساس امنیت می‌کنم
fa.#In the evening or after dark, how secur: شب‌ها یا پس از تاریک شدن هوا، در سفر معمول خود چقدر در برابر جرم یا آزار احساس امنیت می‌کنید؟
fa.#I don't travel in the evening or after: شب‌ها یا پس از تاریک شدن هوا رفت‌وآمد نمی‌کنم
fa.#When you don't feel safe in the evening: وقتی شب‌ها احساس امنیت نمی‌کنید، معمولاً چه کار می‌کنید؟
fa.#I still travel in the evening because I: با این حال شب‌ها رفت‌وآمد می‌کنم چون مجبورم
fa.#I still go out, but I change my route,: با این حال بیرون می‌روم، اما مسیر، ایستگاه یا همراهم را عوض می‌کنم
fa.#I avoid travelling in the evening: از رفت‌وآمد در شب پرهیز می‌کنم
fa.#Which factors most reduce your feeling: کدام عوامل بیش از همه احساس امنیت شما را در برابر جرم یا آزار کاهش می‌دهند؟
fa.#Lack of people around (isolated or dese: کمبود افراد در اطراف (مناطق خلوت یا متروک)
fa.#People behaving aggressively or harassi: افرادی که رفتار پرخاشگرانه دارند یا دیگران را آزار می‌دهند
fa.#Harassment experienced or feared becaus: آزاری که به دلیل ویژگی‌های شخصی یا ظاهرم (مثلاً جنسیت، ظاهر، اصالت، سن) تجربه کرده‌ام یا از آن می‌ترسم
fa.#Long waits at stops in the evening: انتظار طولانی در ایستگاه‌ها در شب
fa.#Poor visibility (e.g., blind corners, o: دید ضعیف (مثلاً گوشه کور، دید بسته)
fa.#Poor maintenance (e.g., abandoned build: نگهداری ضعیف (مثلاً ساختمان متروک، دیوارنویسی، زیرساخت خراب)
fa.#Lack of surveillance or security measur: نبود نظارت یا اقدامات امنیتی (مثلاً نبود دوربین یا کارکنان)
fa.#Previous personal or reported incidents: اتفاق‌های قبلی که خودم تجربه کرده‌ام یا در آن منطقه گزارش شده‌اند
fa.#When you walk after dark, does poor str: وقتی بعد از تاریک شدن هوا پیاده راه می‌روید، آیا روشنایی کم خیابان مسیر یا زمان بیرون رفتن شما را تغییر می‌دهد؟
fa.#I notice it, but I don't change anythin: متوجه می‌شوم، اما چیزی را تغییر نمی‌دهم
fa.#I go the same way but faster, or avoid: همان مسیر را می‌روم، اما سریع‌تر، یا از بعضی نقاط دوری می‌کنم
fa.#I take a longer, better-lit route: مسیری طولانی‌تر و روشن‌تر انتخاب می‌کنم
fa.#I don't walk after dark because of poor: به دلیل روشنایی کم، بعد از تاریک شدن هوا پیاده‌روی نمی‌کنم
fa.#I don't walk after dark for other reaso: به دلایل دیگر بعد از تاریک شدن هوا پیاده‌روی نمی‌کنم
fa.#Lighting doesn't matter to me because I: روشنایی برایم مهم نیست، چون به بینایی تکیه نمی‌کنم
fa.#Street lamp at night with a safety shie: چراغ خیابان در شب با سپر ایمنی

hu.#<p>Questions about road safety and pers:
Kérdések a közlekedésbiztonságról és a személyes biztonságról az utazásai során.

A részvétel önkéntes. Válaszai nem kapcsolódnak a nevéhez. A részletekért olvassa el az adatvédelmi tájékoztatót.
hu.#<p>Questions about safety (protection f: Kérdések a közlekedésbiztonságról (védelem a balesetekkel vagy testi sérüléssel szemben) és a személyes biztonságról (védelem a bűncselekményekkel, a zaklatással és a fenyegetettség érzésével szemben) a szokásos utazásai során.
hu.#<p>Your submission has been recorded. T: Válaszát rögzítettük. Köszönjük, hogy időt szánt a kérdőív kitöltésére.
hu.#Thinking about your typical trip (the t: Szokásos útjára gondolva (amelyet egy átlagos héten a leggyakrabban tesz meg), mennyire biztonságosak az Ön által használt utcák, a járdákat és az átkelőhelyeket is beleértve, a forgalom és az útviszonyok szempontjából?
hu.#When you walk (also with a pushchair, a: Amikor sétál (babakocsival, bottal vagy más segédeszközzel is) vagy kerekesszéket használ, hogyan hatnak Önre a gyors forgalmú utak, amikor mellettük halad vagy átkel rajtuk?
hu.#I feel unsafe and stay near them as lit: Nem érzem magam biztonságban, és a lehető legkevesebbet tartózkodom ott
hu.#I take much longer routes to avoid them: Sokkal hosszabb útvonalakat választok, hogy elkerüljem őket
hu.#I avoid trips that make me use them: Elkerülöm azokat az utakat, ahol használnom kell őket
hu.#Not for me: I rarely get around on foot: Rám nem vonatkozik: ritkán közlekedem gyalog vagy kerekesszékkel
hu.#Which situations on a trip do you consi: Mely helyzeteket tartja a legveszélyesebbnek utazás közben?
hu.#Lack of safe or adequate infrastructure: Biztonságos vagy megfelelő infrastruktúra hiánya (pl. járdák, átkelőhelyek, kerékpárutak, világítás)
hu.#Poor road or pathway conditions (e.g. p: Rossz út- vagy járdaviszonyok (pl. kátyúk, törmelék, egyenetlen felületek)
hu.#Poor visibility or limited sightlines: Rossz látási viszonyok vagy korlátozott beláthatóság
hu.#Unsafe behavior from drivers, riders, o: Járművezetők, kétkerekű járművek használói vagy gyalogosok veszélyes viselkedése
hu.#During the day, how secure do you feel: Napközben mennyire érzi magát biztonságban a bűncselekményekkel vagy a zaklatással szemben a szokásos útja során? (Zaklatásnak számítanak az Önnek címzett kéretlen megjegyzések, a követés, az érintés vagy a megfélemlítő viselkedés.)
hu.#In the evening or after dark, how secur: Este vagy sötétedés után mennyire érzi magát biztonságban a bűncselekményekkel vagy a zaklatással szemben a szokásos útja során?
hu.#I don't travel in the evening or after: Este vagy sötétedés után nem közlekedem
hu.#When you don't feel safe in the evening: Mit szokott tenni, ha este nem érzi magát biztonságban?
hu.#I still go out, but I change my route,: Mégis útra kelek, de más útvonalat, megállót vagy társaságot választok
hu.#Which factors most reduce your feeling: Mely tényezők csökkentik leginkább a bűncselekményekkel vagy a zaklatással szembeni biztonságérzetét?
hu.#Lack of people around (isolated or dese: Kevés vagy egyáltalán nincs ember a közelben (elszigetelt vagy kihalt területek)
hu.#People behaving aggressively or harassi: Agresszívan viselkedő vagy másokat zaklató emberek
hu.#Harassment experienced or feared becaus: Elszenvedett vagy attól tartott zaklatás amiatt, hogy ki vagyok vagy hogyan nézek ki (pl. nem, külső, származás, életkor)
hu.#Overcrowding or chaotic environments: Túl nagy tömeg vagy kaotikus környezet
hu.#Poor visibility (e.g., blind corners, o: Rossz beláthatóság (pl. beláthatatlan sarkok, akadályozott kilátás)
hu.#Poor maintenance (e.g., abandoned build: Rossz karbantartás (pl. elhagyott épületek, graffiti, sérült infrastruktúra)
hu.#Lack of surveillance or security measur: Megfigyelés vagy biztonsági intézkedések hiánya (pl. nincs kamera, nincs személyzet)
hu.#Previous personal or reported incidents: Korábbi személyes vagy bejelentett esetek a környéken
hu.#When you walk after dark, does poor str: Ha sötétedés után sétál, megváltoztatja-e a rossz közvilágítás az útvonalát vagy azt, hogy mikor indul el otthonról?
hu.#I go the same way but faster, or avoid: Ugyanazon az úton megyek, de gyorsabban, vagy kerülök bizonyos helyeket
hu.#I don't walk after dark because of poor: Rossz világítás miatt sötétedés után nem sétálok
hu.#I don't walk after dark for other reaso: Más okok miatt sötétedés után nem sétálok
hu.#Lighting doesn't matter to me because I: A világítás nem számít nekem, mert nem a látásomra támaszkodom
hu.#Street lamp at night with a safety shie: Utcai lámpa éjszaka egy biztonsági pajzzsal

ar.#<p>Questions about road safety and pers:
أسئلة عن السلامة على الطريق والأمان الشخصي أثناء تنقلاتك.

المشاركة طوعية. لا ترتبط إجاباتك باسمك. للتفاصيل، يُرجى الاطلاع على معلومات الخصوصية.
ar.#<p>Questions about safety (protection f: أسئلة عن السلامة (الحماية من حوادث الطرق أو الأذى الجسدي) والأمان (الحماية من الجرائم أو التحرش أو الشعور بعدم الأمان) أثناء تنقلاتك المعتادة.
ar.#<p>Your submission has been recorded. T: تم تسجيل إجابتك. شكرًا لوقتك في إكمال هذا الاستبيان.
ar.#Thinking about your typical trip (the t: بالتفكير في رحلتك المعتادة (الرحلة الأكثر تكرارًا في أسبوع عادي)، ما مدى أمان الطرق المستخدمة، بما فيها الأرصفة ومعابر المشاة، من حيث حركة المرور وحالة الطريق؟
ar.#When you walk (also with a pushchair, a: عند المشي (ولو مع عربة أطفال أو عكاز أو أداة مساعدة) أو استخدام كرسي متحرك، كيف تؤثر فيك الطرق ذات الحركة السريعة عند السير بمحاذاتها أو عبورها؟
ar.#I feel unsafe and stay near them as lit: أشعر بعدم الأمان وأقضي بقربها أقل وقت ممكن
ar.#I avoid trips that make me use them: أتجنب الرحلات التي تجبرني على استخدامها
ar.#I don't use roads like these: لا أستخدم طرقًا من هذا النوع
ar.#Not for me: I rarely get around on foot: لا ينطبق عليّ: نادرًا ما أتنقل مشيًا أو بكرسي متحرك
ar.#Which situations on a trip do you consi: ما المواقف الأكثر خطورة أثناء التنقل برأيك؟
ar.#Lack of safe or adequate infrastructure: غياب بنية تحتية آمنة أو مناسبة (مثل الأرصفة، المعابر، مسارات الدراجات، الإضاءة)
ar.#Poor road or pathway conditions (e.g. p: سوء حالة الطريق أو المسار (مثل الحفر أو المخلفات أو الأسطح غير المستوية)
ar.#Poor visibility or limited sightlines: ضعف الرؤية أو محدودية مجال النظر
ar.#Unsafe behavior from drivers, riders, o: سلوك خطير من أشخاص يقودون السيارات أو الدراجات أو يسيرون على الأقدام
ar.#Crowding or conflicts with other road u: الازدحام أو التعارض مع أشخاص آخرين يستخدمون الطريق
ar.#During the day, how secure do you feel: خلال النهار، ما مدى شعورك بالأمان من الجرائم أو التحرش في رحلتك المعتادة؟ (يشمل التحرش التعليقات غير المرغوب فيها أو الملاحقة أو اللمس أو السلوك الترهيبي الموجّه إليك.)
ar.#In the evening or after dark, how secur: في المساء أو بعد حلول الظلام، ما مدى شعورك بالأمان من الجرائم أو التحرش في رحلتك المعتادة؟
ar.#I don't travel in the evening or after: لا أتنقل في المساء أو بعد حلول الظلام
ar.#When you don't feel safe in the evening: عندما لا تشعر بالأمان في المساء، ماذا تفعل عادةً؟
ar.#I still travel in the evening because I: أتنقل مساءً رغم ذلك لأن الأمر ضروري
